tokens.name: product-primary
tokens.usage: Brand blue for links, headings, card titles, icons and focus outlines on `product-surface`, `product-surface-muted` and `product-canvas` (10.6:1 light, 7.2:1 dark). Never a filled button background: in dark it is a light tint.

tokens.name: product-primary-strong
tokens.usage: Calendar link and nav-button text on `product-canvas` (12.7:1 light / 11.0:1 dark), event counts on `product-primary-soft` (12.2:1 / 10.0:1), hover color for detail links.

tokens.name: product-primary-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground for tags and card action buttons (with `product-primary` text, 9.6:1 light / 7.3:1 dark) and the resting demo-card border. Also the detail heading ground, the selected series chip and calendar day hover; `product-text-muted` on it is 4.5:1 (light).

tokens.name: product-action-bg
tokens.usage: Filled primary-action background: buttons, skip link, header gradient start. Pair with `product-on-action` (10.6:1 light / 6.4:1 dark).

tokens.name: product-action-hover
tokens.usage: Hover state of `product-action-bg`; header gradient end. `product-on-action` on it: 5.0:1 dark.

tokens.name: product-on-action
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `product-action-bg`, `product-action-hover` and the header.

tokens.name: product-accent
tokens.usage: Brand orange: sparing highlight (hero glow, accent fills). Text on it is `product-on-accent` (5.5:1), never white. ⚠ The detail page uses it as a 3px focus ring; on white that is 2.9:1 (below 3:1). Prefer a `product-primary` ring (see README › Consistency).

tokens.name: product-accent-strong
tokens.usage: Orange used as text: on `product-accent-soft` (6.3:1 light) and on `product-surface` (8.6:1 dark).

tokens.name: product-accent-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted orange ground for notices and highlights; text in `product-accent-strong`.

tokens.name: product-surface
tokens.usage: Cards, header nav bar, dropdowns, calendars, modals.

tokens.name: product-surface-muted
tokens.usage: Public page body background; filter chips and inset panels.

tokens.name: product-border
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers and control outlines. Decorative contrast only (1.3:1 light, 1.8:1 dark): never the sole separation of an interactive control.

tokens.name: product-text
tokens.usage: Body copy on `product-surface`, `product-surface-muted` and `product-canvas` (15.3:1 light, 14.1:1 dark).

tokens.name: product-pride-gradient
tokens.usage: Decorative Pride badge border only; text sits on solid product-surface.

tokens.name: product-text-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary copy: card date/time/location, help text, on `product-surface` (5.0:1 light / 8.4:1 dark) and `product-surface-muted` (4.7:1 / 7.3:1).

tokens.name: product-success
tokens.usage: Success text and icons on `product-success-soft` (4.9:1 light / 8.9:1 dark). Always paired with a word or icon.

tokens.name: product-danger
tokens.usage: Danger text, destructive action and error icons on `product-danger-soft` (5.9:1 light / 7.3:1 dark).

tokens.name: flash-card-bg
tokens.usage: Flash toast card and its icon disc (fallback value hard-coded in flash.css).

tokens.name: flash-success-icon
tokens.usage: Success toast icon, left rule and progress bar.

tokens.name: flash-error-icon
tokens.usage: Error toast icon, left rule and progress bar.

tokens.name: flash-warning-icon
tokens.usage: Warning toast icon, left rule and progress bar.

tokens.name: flash-info-icon
tokens.usage: Info toast icon, left rule and progress bar.

tokens.name: hero-mid
tokens.usage: Site-hero gradient, 58% stop. White hero copy on it: 7.8:1 light / 10.4:1 dark.

tokens.name: hero-on-primary
tokens.usage: Label of the white primary button inside a hero.

tokens.name: badge-today
tokens.usage: "Tänään" badge fill. White label on it is only 3.1:1 (source value kept; fails 4.5:1 for its 0.74rem text).

tokens.name: pride-red
tokens.usage: Pride gradient stop 1 (Pride badge and card ring only).

tokens.name: pride-violet
tokens.usage: Pride gradient stop 6; also tints the Pride card glow.
